response.sql:
WITH account_averages AS (
    SELECT
        t.account_id,
        d.A3 AS region,
        AVG(t.amount) AS account_avg
    FROM trans AS t
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3
),
region_averages AS (
    SELECT region, AVG(account_avg) AS region_avg
    FROM account_averages
    GROUP BY region
),
region_stats AS (
    SELECT
        region,
        region_avg,
        AVG(region_avg) OVER () AS all_region_avg
    FROM region_averages
),
above_regions AS (
    SELECT region, region_avg, all_region_avg
    FROM region_stats
    WHERE region_avg > all_region_avg
)
SELECT
    region,
    region_avg AS figure,
    region_avg - all_region_avg AS excess,
    region_avg / AVG(region_avg) OVER () AS ratio_to_above_average_mean
FROM above_regions;

assumptions.assumption: Accounts with no transactions are excluded because no transaction average can be computed for them; regions with no such account averages are likewise excluded from the all-region average.
